description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the Afghanistan Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022, which calls for 4.44 billion USD to reach 22.1 million people with humanitarian assistance.

This allocation of 17.5 million DKK to the UN Afghanistan Humanitarian Fund contributes to meeting the objectives of the Afghanistan Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022, which points to 24.4 million people in need and calls for 4.44 billion USD to reach 22.1 million people with humanitarian assistance. The Humanitarian Response Plan aims at reaching 21.6 million people with food security and agricultural assistance; 14.7 million people with health assistance; 10.4 million with water, sanitation and hygiene; 5.9 million with nutrition assistance; 4.5 million with protection; 1.9 million with emergency shelter and non-food items; and 1.5 million with education.
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the Afghanistan Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022, which calls for 4.44 billion USD to reach 22.1 million people with humanitarian assistance.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.undp.org/results
